mapper.select: SELECT * FROM expense_partial_adjustment_preparation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM expense_partial_adjustment_preparation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND adjustment_id=#{adjustment} AND side=#{side} AND requested_by=#{actor} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id FROM expense_partial_adjustment_preparation q LEFT JOIN expense_partial_adjustment origin ON origin.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND origin.id=q.adjustment_id AND origin.report_id=q.report_id LEFT JOIN expense_report report ON report.tenant_id=origin.tenant_id AND report.id=origin.report_id LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND business.id=report.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=origin.round_no WHERE q.status='QUEUED' OR (q.status='RUNNING' AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT input_json FROM expense_partial_adjustment_preparation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE expense_partial_adjustment_preparation SET state_json=#{stateJson},version=#{version},status=#{status},active_slot=#{active},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND input_json=#{originalInput} AND status<>'AUTHORIZED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM expense_partial_adjustment_authorization WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND preparation_id=#{id}
SELECT state_json FROM expense_partial_adjustment_preparation_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND preparation_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
